findings.note: Accurate and complete as written. 'client list' takes cobra.NoArgs and declares no flags, so there is no parameter to name and no filter to describe; it returns the saved client-profile names. Verb-led and action-specific already - more words would pad, not inform.

Real finding, but not fixable here: teach.go is a DO-NOT-EDIT generated file, so a hand-edit is wiped on the next regen. 'learnings list' declares 7 filters (--query, --action, --source, --resource, --min-confidence, --limit, --warnings) that a parameter-aware Short should name. Needs a generator-template fix; raised as a retro candidate.
